sloka: स रामाय नमस्कृत्वा राज्ञे दशरथाय च ।विसृष्टस्तेन वीरेण प्रतिपेदे स्वमालयम् ।। ५.३८.३८।।णम् ।।।
transliteration: sa rāmāya namaskṛtvā rājñe daśarathāya ca ।visṛṣṭastena vīreṇa pratipede svamālayam ।। 5.38.38।।ṇam ।।।

translations.english: 'That crow offered salutations to you Rama and king Dasaratha, thereafter took permission and went to his own dwelling.
